biggest_catch: The $100 bonus only arrives after 12 consecutive months of $100+ monthly deposits with a $1,200+ balance at the end — about 13 months before payout.
catches: New Alliant Credit Union members only; one-time payout per member; apply online from the promo page by 11:59 p.m. CT on December 31, 2026.
Offer valid for savings accounts opened January 1, 2026 through December 31, 2026.

Fund the account with transfers/deposits totaling $100 or more each month for 12 consecutive months; the first $100 must be transferred/deposited within 30 days of account opening and each subsequent month's funds must post by the last day of the month.
Account must remain open and in good standing, maintain a minimum average daily balance of $100, and have a balance of $1,200 or more at the end of the 12-month period.
Accounts are reviewed 12 months from the first transfer/deposit; allow 4 weeks after the review for the $100 bonus deposit to post.
Existing Alliant members, joint owners on Alliant savings accounts, and members who closed an Alliant savings account within 180 days of applying are not eligible.
Not transferable; not valid for UTMAs, IRAs, or other tax-exempt accounts; taxes are the member's responsibility.
Must be 18+ and a legal U.S. Resident or U.S. Person; Alliant Board, employees, and their household family members are not eligible.

steps: Apply online from the official promo page (promo.alliantcreditunion.org/ultimate-opportunity-savings) by 12/31/2026 to open the High-Rate/Ultimate Opportunity Savings Account as a new Alliant member.
Within 30 days of account opening, make your first transfer/deposit of at least $100.
Continue depositing at least $100 per calendar month for 12 consecutive months (each month's funds must post by the last day of the month).
Keep the account open and in good standing with a minimum $100 average daily balance and a $1,200+ balance at the end of the 12-month period.
After the 12-month review, the $100 bonus is automatically deposited within 4 weeks.
timing: Bonus deposited within 4 weeks after the 12-month eligibility review (12 consecutive months of $100+ deposits; $1,200+ balance at end of period).
when_cash_arrives: Bonus $100. Per official terms: Bonus deposited within 4 weeks after the 12-month eligibility review (12 consecutive months of $100+ deposits; $1,200+ balance at end of period). Earliest realistic: ~13.0 months (12 monthly DD cycles + up to 1 month).
maximize: Fastest honest path. The offer requires consecutive months of direct deposits — payroll cycles are the hard floor and cannot be compressed. Fastest honest path: set up a real payroll direct deposit immediately (Zelle/bank transfers typically don't count) and keep it running uninterrupted; a missed month restarts the clock.
